r1-1.notes: Falcon on shoulder, gloved hand forward.

r1-4.notes: Canonical pose: robot falcon perched on her raised gloved fist (glove screen, tassel), braid over her right shoulder with olive bow, field jacket with wing patch, mustard neckerchief, long plaid skirt; quiver on back. Face centre ~31% across (eyes midpoint x 230) - inside the band but at its left edge. Background meadow, stone wall, mountains, birdhouse - decent, academy not shown.

r1-6.notes: Falcon on shoulder (chunky owl-like head), gloved hand reaching to the viewer, clock tower; close alternative (8.2).
